body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Optoma introduced its 3D gaming projector 'GT720' during CES 2010, which supports 1080p resolution, 3000:1 contrast ratio and 2500 ANSI lumens, and adopts a built-in 10W speaker.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
